mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias in patients receiving beta-blockers; carvedilol may mask symptoms of severe hypocalcemia.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) closely during foscarnet therapy; consider EKG monitoring and adjust carvedilol dosing if significant electrolyte derangements occur.
